description: This image presents a two-level sunburst or nested pie chart illustrating a hierarchical breakdown of analysis categories, likely related to the referenced benchmark for deep reasoning in audio. The chart consists of an inner ring with four main categories and an outer ring subdivided into sixteen specific analysis types. The inner ring's slices are ordered clockwise in descending order of size, starting from the right. The largest inner slice is the "Semantic Layer" (light blue), accounting for 41.2%, which subdivides in the outer ring into three light blue slices: "Content Analysis", "Emotion & Intention", and "Speaker Analysis". The second largest is the "Perception Layer" (dark blue) at 40.4%, which breaks down into six medium blue outer slices: "Environmental Perception & Reasoning", "Counting & Statistics", "Music Theory", "Correlation Analysis", "Temporal Analysis", and "Spatial Analysis". The third inner slice is the "Cultural Layer" (grey) at 14.1%, subdivided into four grey outer slices: "Professional Knowl & Reasoning", "Culture of Speaker", "Imagination", and "Asthetic Analysis". The smallest inner slice is the "Signal Layer" (medium blue) at 4.3%, which splits into three medium blue outer slices: "Acoustic Quality Analysis", "Anomaly Detection", and a very thin third slice whose label is partially obscured by a grey rectangular artifact, ending in the word "Analysis". The chart does not include a separate legend, as all labels and inner-ring percentages are placed directly within or adjacent to their respective segments. The text is angled to follow the curvature of the chart, and no slices are visually exploded or offset from the central donut hole.
